review_candidates.description: Bygg med oss och få branschens bästa kollegor På NCC drivs vi av att fortsätta utvecklas, oavsett om det handlar om våra byggprojekt eller vår personliga kompetens. Varje dag driver vi branschens mest spännande och komplexa byggprojekt framåt i ett nära samarbete mellan våra medarbetare, samarbetsparters och kunder. Hos oss är du en betydelsefull medarbetare som bidrar till de landmärken som definierar våra städer och samhällen. Här tar våra medarbetare en aktiv roll i en företagskultur grundad på stabila värderingar och beteenden för en trygg och säker arbetsplats. Vår samlade kompetens och varierande bakgrund gör skillnad. NCC - ett av de ledande företagen i Norden Projektdirektör till Building Stora Projekt Vi söker en erfaren och affärsdriven Projektdirektör som vill ta sig an en unik möjlighet. Du kommer att bygga och leda en organisation som tillsammans ska förverkliga ett komplext miljardprojekt. Tjänsten innebär ett övergripande ansvar för ett projekt med hög komplexitet både utifrån storlek och teknik och investeringsvolymer på flera miljarder kronor. Framgång bygger på starkt ledarskap, strategiskt tänkande och förmågan att skapa resultat. Tjänsten som Projektdirektör Som Projektdirektör ansvarar du för att leda projekt genom hela livscykeln, från utveckling och planering till genomförande, överlämning och uppföljning. Du har det övergripande ansvaret för ekonomi, tid, kvalitet, risker och resurser samt säkerställer att projektmålen uppnås enligt affärsmässiga krav. Tillsammans med ledningsgruppen driver du projektets strategiska utveckling och resultat, samtidigt som du ansvarar för resursplanering och effektiva informations- och kommunikationsflöden. Du leder en projektorganisation med ett flertal delprojekt, entreprenörer, konsulter och specialistfunktioner. Du fungerar som en central företrädare gentemot kunder, myndigheter, partners och andra strategiska intressenter och har en avgörande roll i att bygga förtroende, Du ansvarar också för att skapa en positiv kultur och stark laganda inom projektet, samt att säkerställa en god arbetsmiljö och effektiva arbetssätt. Att bygga och upprätthålla goda relationer med kunden och andra intressenter är ofta avgörande för projektets framgång. Du ingår även i Division Stora Projekts ledningsgrupp där du förväntas ta en aktiv roll. Din profil som Projektdirektör Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda och bygga stora multidisciplinära team där ditt ledarskap är en av dina starkaste sidor. Naturligtvis drivs du även av att göra bra affärer, har bred kompetens inom projektstyrning, entreprenadjuridik, ekonomi och riskhantering. Du kommer förmodligen från entreprenadsidan eller beställarsidan men även industribakgrund kan vara intressant för oss. Du är en strateg som håller ihop din organisation utifrån gemensamt satta mål och med höga krav på genomförande. Du är en trygg ledare som skapar engagemang och tydlighet även i utmanande situationer. Du behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. B-körkort är ett krav Om Division Building Stora Projekt Divisionen Building Stora Projekt utvecklar och leder komplexa byggprojekt med ett ordervärde i storleksordningen 1,5 miljarder eller mer. Är du intresserad av andra möjligheter? Vi rekryterar parallellt med denna tjänst följande roller; Kommersiell chef, KMA-chef, Produktionschef, Teknisk chef och Lead Planner. Läs mer på ncc.se NCC erbjuder NCC vill vara en attraktiv arbetsgivare med medarbetare som trivs och utvecklas så därför erbjuder vi dig ett stort utbud av personalförmåner och internutbildningar. NCC har kollektivavtal för alla medarbetare vilket ger dig en bra grundtrygghet och ett tydligt regelverk så att du vet vad som gäller för din anställning. Vi erbjuder även försäkringar, arbetstidsförkortning, friskvårdsbidrag samt lunchförmån. Ytterligare erbjudanden och rabatter hittar du via vår förmånsportal Benify. Ytterligare information Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Placeringsorten är flexibel utifrån projektets förutsättningar. Tjänsten förutsätter att du har möjlighet att resa i tjänsten. För den här tjänsten genomför vi bakgrundskontroll i enligt med NCC:s säkerhetskultur. Divisionen kan komma att arbeta med säkerhetsklassade projekt varför säkerhetsprövning kan komma att genomföras. Kontakt och ansökan Vill du veta mer om tjänsten vänligen kontakta Tobias Holmqvist, Division chef, tobias.holmqvist@ncc.se. Då annonsen ligger ute delvis över semestern ber vi därför om överseende med att eventuella frågor inte kan besvaras under veckorna 28–32. Sista ansökningsdagen är den 6 september 2026. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Ensure all teams follow established procedures and policies to support accurate reporting and project execution. Oversee the Procure-to-Pay cycle for assigned projects, including review of requisition and purchase order coding to the correct WBS elements, monitoring of goods receipt/invoice receipt (GR/IR) aging, and resolution of three-way match exceptions with procurement and accounts payable. Monitor open commitments, accruals, and actual costs in SAP to produce a complete and defensible estimate at completion (EAC) for each project, including quantification of risk, contingency, and pending change orders. Maintain project master data integrity across SAP modules, including cost centers, profit centers, activity types, settlement rules, and project system statuses, and coordinate with ERP support on issue resolution and enhancement requests. Prepare and update detailed project cash flow forecasts to ensure adequate funding and timely disbursements. Coordinate with finance and project teams to align cash flow timing with billing, procurement, and execution milestones. Collaborate with project managers, procurement, and scheduling teams to align operational activities with financial plans. Support resource planning and identify risks that may impact cost or schedule. Assist in preparing documentation and reports for external audits. Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records and support compliance with internal Controller. Identify inefficiencies in project Controller and recommend process enhancements. Develop standardized tools, templates, and reporting formats to improve accuracy and consistency. Monitor compliance with company issued policies and procedures and take corrective action for non-compliance. Review and approve job cost transfers to ensure accuracy, proper justification, and alignment with project budgets and coding structures. Investigate project variances, submit variance reports to management and respond to requests for more detail from key stakeholders. Provide ongoing process and financial guidance to project teams and other departments whose activities impact project financials. Support informed decision-making by ensuring understanding of cost Controller, budgeting practices, and compliance requirements. Close out projects and project accounts upon project completion. Review daily operational and financial transactions (Purchasing, Invoice Logs, JSI) and investigate any unusual transaction. Establish clear deadlines for project financial deliverables and monitor compliance across teams. Identify and prioritize critical areas requiring timely action to prevent delays, cost overruns, or reporting gaps. Perform various month-end closing procedures, including preparation and review of project cost reports. Ensure all costs are captured, reconciled, and accurately reflected in financial systems. Respond to ad hoc requests from management or project teams by providing timely financial analysis, reports, or data as needed. Support revenue recognition for long-term contracts, including percentage-of-completion calculations, results analysis, and settlement in SAP PS, in accordance with ASC 606 and company accounting policy. Track client billings, retainage, and unbilled balances; support the preparation of progress billings and reconcile billed and recognized revenue to the project cost report. Prepare and issue monthly project review packages covering cost to date, estimate at completion, margin trend, contingency drawdown, cash position, and change order status for review with project managers and executive leadership. Participate in ERP and process improvement initiatives, including requirements gathering, user acceptance testing, and training of project teams on SAP workflows and reporting tools. Protect the confidentiality of all accounting and payroll data. Prepares for ISO 9001 and other audits. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Variance between reported estimate at completion and final project cost. Timeliness of GR/IR clearing and resolution of three-way match and invoice exceptions. Completeness of documentation supporting reported contract values, budgets, and approved change orders. Accuracy and integrity of project master data maintained in SAP S/4HANA. Absence of audit findings related to project financial records and internal Controller. Competencies Strong organizational skills. Independent work skills. Analytical, logic and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented with emphasis on accuracy and detection of errors and/or potential fraud. Ability to prioritize work to meet established deadlines. Strong interpersonal skills. Written and verbal communication skills. Time management. Accounting and Financial skills and knowledge. Job cost and project accounting concepts. Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities. Collaborative, cross-functional approach to problem solving. Key Working Relationships Project Managers and Project Engineers – cost, forecast, change order, and closeout coordination. Procurement and Receiving – purchase order commitments, goods receipt, and supplier invoice resolution. Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable – invoice processing, progress billing, and collections support. Scheduling – alignment of cost and schedule data for progress and earned value reporting. Corporate Accounting – month-end close, revenue recognition, and audit support. ERP and IT Support – system access, master data, and issue escalation. Work Environment Most work is performed in an office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Physical Demands This is a largely sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. Position Type/Expected Hours of Work This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand. Required Education And Experience. Bachelor degree in accounting and 3 to 5 years of relevant experience; or 10 years’ relevant experience. Preferred Education And Experience Job cost and project accounting. SAP S/4HANA experience. SAP Project Systems (PS) module, including WBS structures, project budgeting, cost planning, and settlement. Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process experience, including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, goods receipt, and invoice verification (three-way match). Experience in an engineering, construction, EPC, or capital equipment manufacturing environment with long-cycle projects. Experience supporting international projects, including multi-currency and intercompany transactions. CPA, CMA, or CCP certification, or active progress toward certification. review_candidates.title: Journaliste Économie – Jeune Afrique
review_candidates.description: À propos de nous Fondé en 1960, Jeune Afrique Media Group (JAMG) est le premier groupe média consacré à l'Afrique et un acteur majeur de l'événementiel de haut niveau sur le continent. Fort d'une expertise éditoriale internationalement reconnue et d'une présence locale solide, JAMG fournit aux décideurs les analyses approfondies, les informations fiables et les services essentiels à la compréhension des enjeux politiques, économiques et sociaux du continent. Nos trois titres incarnent cette mission : Jeune Afrique, mensuel francophone de référence depuis plus de six décennies , The Africa Report, trimestriel anglophone qui porte la voix du continent à l'international , et Africa Business+, plateforme digitale dédiée à l'intelligence économique africaine. Le digital constitue aujourd'hui le premier levier de développement de nos titres, avec des audiences en forte croissance sur le web et les applications mobiles. Parallèlement, JAMG s'est imposé comme un organisateur de conférences économiques internationales de premier plan. L'Africa CEO Forum, plus grand rassemblement du secteur privé africain, réunit chaque année plus de 3 000 dirigeants, chefs d'État et investisseurs autour des grandes transformations du continent. L'Africa Financial Summit, événement phare de l'industrie financière africaine, fédère quant à lui les acteurs clés de la banque, de l'assurance et des marchés de capitaux. Ces rendez-vous de haut niveau positionnent JAMG au cœur des décisions qui façonnent l'économie africaine. Le groupe est également présent dans l'édition et la production audiovisuelle. Depuis plus de soixante ans, JAMG joue un rôle clé dans les relations économiques et politiques entre l'Afrique et le reste du monde. Si vous partagez notre engagement, notre quête d'excellence, notre esprit africain et notre goût du collectif, rejoignez Jeune Afrique Media Group ! Mission Le poste Au sein de la Rédaction de Jeune Afrique, le/la Journaliste Économie contribue à la couverture de l'actualité économique du continent africain dans toutes ses dimensions : grandes tendances macroéconomiques, dynamiques sectorielles, stratégies d'entreprises et jeux d'acteurs qui façonnent les économies africaines et leurs relations avec le reste du monde. Couverture éditoriale Couvre l'actualité économique du continent au sens large : conjoncture, politiques économiques, financement du développement, mais aussi actualités sectorielles elon l'agenda éditorial et les priorités de la rédaction. Traite l'information sous des angles variés (décryptages, analyses, enquêtes, interviews, portraits, papiers d'actualité chaude) en s'adaptant aux différents formats et supports du groupe. Peut être amené(e) à prendre en charge des thématiques ou zones géographiques spécifiques, en fonction de l'actualité et de ses appétences. Veille, analyse et réseau Suit et analyse l'actualité des principales institutions internationales, panafricaines et régionales ainsi que celle des grandes entreprises et investisseurs actifs sur le continent. Développe et entretient un réseau solide de contacts auprès des décideurs politiques, dirigeants d'entreprises, économistes, financiers, entrepreneurs et analystes influents de l'économie africaine. Met en place et actualise en continu un mapping des institutions, entreprises, personnalités et thématiques prioritaires à suivre, contribuant ainsi à la veille collective de la rédaction. Terrain et événements Réalise des missions de terrain en Afrique de l'Ouest, centrale et du Nord, selon l'actualité et les besoins éditoriaux (reportages, couverture d'événements économiques majeurs, sommets et forums). Collabore avec le pôle Event de Jeune Afrique Media Group pour la conception et la production de contenus éditoriaux dans le cadre des conférences et forums organisés par le groupe (Africa CEO Forum, notamment). Contribue à l'animation éditoriale du pôle Économie : propositions de sujets en conférence de rédaction, suggestions d'angles et de formats, participation à la réflexion sur les nouveaux rendez-vous éditoriaux. Profil Formation et expérience Formation supérieure en journalisme, économie, sciences politiques ou équivalent. Première expérience réussie en journalisme économique (presse écrite, digital, agence ou média spécialisé), quelle que soit la spécialité couverte jusqu'ici. Compétences et connaissances Solide culture économique et financière, curiosité pour l'ensemble des secteurs d'activité et capacité à monter rapidement en compétence sur de nouveaux sujets. Intérêt marqué pour le continent africain, ses économies et ses acteurs ; une connaissance préalable d'une ou plusieurs régions est un plus. Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles en français ; capacité à rendre accessibles des sujets complexes. Anglais professionnel indispensable (lecture de rapports, interviews, couverture d'institutions internationales). Soft Skills Rigueur, réactivité, autonomie et goût du travail en équipe. Aisance relationnelle et capacité à construire et faire vivre un réseau de sources de haut niveau. Disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers sur le continent. Référence de l'offre : roosjvdo0t

The successful candidate will develop a deep understanding of our members' investment strategies, portfolios, capital allocation preferences, areas of interest, and investment mandates. They will then work with the Berkana team to identify relevant opportunities, assess their fit for individual members, and facilitate high-quality investment connections. The role sits at the intersection of private wealth, family offices, investment analysis, private markets, and investor relationships. Build and maintain investment profiles covering asset classes, sectors, geographies, ticket sizes, risk appetite, investment horizon, and liquidity preferences. Understand what each principal is actively looking to invest in and where they have existing exposure. Maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion when handling UHNW investor information. Investment Opportunities Review and analyse investment opportunities relevant to Berkana members. Evaluate opportunities across VC, PE, private credit, real estate, deep tech, AI, impact, and other private-market strategies. Prepare concise investment briefs and opportunity summaries. Identify which Berkana members may be relevant for specific opportunities. Coordinate introductions between members and founders, fund managers, family offices, and other investment counterparties. Support members during initial evaluation and diligence processes. Identify potential co-investment and syndication opportunities between Berkana members. Investment Research & Intelligence Research investment themes, sectors, funds, managers, and emerging opportunities. Track developments across global private markets. Develop investment insights and intelligence for the Berkana community. Build and maintain a high-quality database of investment managers, funds, companies, family offices, and investment opportunities. Identify emerging investment themes that may be particularly relevant to UHNW women and family offices. Family Office & Investment Network Develop relationships with family offices, private equity and venture capital funds, private banks, asset managers, founders, investment professionals, and other relevant counterparties. Source high-quality investment opportunities for the Berkana ecosystem. Represent Berkana at selected investment meetings, private dinners, family-office gatherings, conferences, and roundtables. Develop a strong understanding of the GCC and international family-office ecosystem. Support for Berkana's Growth The primary focus of this role is investment, but the successful candidate will also support the development of Berkana's platform by: Identifying potential UHNW women and family offices who could be relevant to Berkana. Supporting strategic relationships with investment institutions and family offices. Identifying potential partnerships and co-investment opportunities. Contributing investment expertise to Berkana's events, roundtables, and member programming. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who understands how sophisticated capital is allocated. You may currently be working as a: Investment Manager Family Office Investment Manager Private Banker Wealth Manager Investment Advisor Private Markets Investment Professional Private Equity Associate / VP Venture Capital Associate / VP Family Office Advisor Investment Analyst / Associate Asset Management professional Requirements 5+ years of relevant experience in investment management, family office, private banking, wealth management, VC, PE, private markets, or investment advisory. Strong understanding of investment analysis and capital allocation. Strong knowledge of private markets and alternative investments. Experience working with UHNW individuals, family offices, institutional investors, or sophisticated private investors. Ability to analyse investment opportunities and communicate investment theses clearly. Strong financial and analytical skills. Excellent research and due-diligence capabilities. Strong understanding of portfolio construction and asset allocation. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills. High level of discretion and professionalism. Strong English communication skills. Existing relationships within the family-office or investment ecosystem are highly desirable. GCC experience is highly desirable. What We Are Looking For Beyond the CV We are particularly interested in candidates who can think like an investor and communicate like a trusted adviser. You should be comfortable sitting with a single-family-office principal and discussing: “What are you investing in?” “What are you looking for? “What is missing from your portfolio?” “What opportunities are you interested in?” “What would make you invest?” You should then be able to translate that understanding into relevant investment opportunities and meaningful connections. Success in This Role The successful candidate will become a trusted investment resource for Berkana's members and will help build the investment intelligence and infrastructure behind the Berkana platform. Key measures of success will include: Quality of member investment profiles and intelligence. Quality and relevance of investment opportunities sourced. Number and quality of investment relationships developed. Investment opportunities successfully matched with members. Co-investment and syndication opportunities generated. Quality of investment research and insights provided to members. Strength of the family-office and private-markets network developed. Why Berkana This is an opportunity to work directly within a growing global network of UHNW women investors and family-office principals, with exposure to venture capital, private equity, deep tech, AI, impact investing, and private markets. Berkana's broader mission is to strengthen the role of women as capital allocators and connect their capital with opportunities capable of shaping both financial outcomes and the future they want to build. To Apply: Please submit your CV and a short note outlining your experience working with UHNW individuals, family offices, investments, and private markets. Compensation USD 10,000–15,000 monthly base salary, depending on experience and seniority, plus: Performance-based annual bonus linked to investment activity, member engagement, quality of opportunities sourced, and contribution to Berkana's investment platform; and Potential participation in the economics of qualifying investment transactions, subject to the structure of each transaction and applicable agreements.
